title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
title_zh: AHE-Beta：以需求为中心的 agent harness 演化方法
abstract: Real-world harness engineering is driven by explicit and implicit user requirements, which guide development and validation. However, existing harness evolution methods often overlook implicit requirements and interaction needs, while using a single evolution agent to modify the harness and benchmark scores to select changes. This process often produces narrow patches and leads to benchmark-specific local optima. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta), a requirement-centered loop that brings real-world engineering practices into harness evolution. The loop consists of three steps: (1) User-driven evaluation lets simulated users raise their requirements as issues while they work with the harness over multiple turns. (2) Team-based modification implements those requirements as generalizable changes rather than task-specific patches. (3) Requirement-driven selection merges a change only when it resolves a verified requirement and passes review. Empirically, on held-out tasks, AHE-Beta raises pass@1 from 21.9% to 33.3% while using 40.8% fewer tokens than Base Harness, and achieves higher pass@1 than Claude Code, Meta-Harness, and AHE. In a blind human A/B test, real users prefer AHE-Beta in 31 of 48 valid pairs and rate it higher on all five dimensions, matching the directional preference of the user simulator. The human A/B results show that AHE-Beta achieves its goal of aligning harness evolution with real-world user requirements. Without further evolution, the gains transfer to GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with pass@1 improvements of 15.8% and 5.3% over Base Harness. Together, these results show that requirement-centered harness evolution is a more general method for improving agent capabilities.
summary_zh: 现有 harness 演化方法常忽略隐式需求且依赖单一 agent 修改，易陷入 benchmark 局部最优。
提出 AHE-Beta 方法，通过模拟用户多轮评估、团队化通用修改与需求驱动选择，将真实工程实践引入演化。
实验表明该方法显著提升 pass@1 并降低 token 消耗，在盲测中获用户偏好，且增益可迁移至其他 LLM。
结论表明以需求为中心的 harness 演化是提升 agent 能力的更通用方法。

title: Who are you? The Personal Imitation Game
title_zh: 你是谁？个人模仿游戏
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) now perform strongly on Alan Turing's 1950 Imitation Game, so we propose a harder challenge, the Personal Imitation Game, which asks whether a machine can replicate a specific individual in conversation rather than a generic human. Testing with 30 participants, we establish a human baseline and report the identity signals interrogators rely on: stylometric features, personality traits, and biographical facts. To demonstrate the framework, we design an LLM-based system that plays the game for one of the paper's authors, drawing on an autoethnographic dataset spanning ten years of personal digital communication. In a 20-person deception study, interrogators choose our system over the author's own friends in 7 of 10 rounds, and the author over our system in 13 of 20; neither rate is distinguishable from chance at this sample size. We consider design improvements, applications of personal AI agents, and implications for identity and privacy.
summary_zh: 传统LLM在图灵测试中表现优异，但难以复制特定个体的对话风格，因此提出更具挑战性的个人模仿游戏框架。
通过30名参与者测试确立人类基线，发现审问者依赖文体特征、人格特质和传记事实等身份信号进行判断。
构建基于LLM的系统参与实验，结果表明该系统在模仿特定个体时与真人难以区分，并探讨了个人AI agent的隐私影响。

title: Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
title_zh: 电力电子仿真中的本地AI Agent：部署、测量与成本
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging in power electronics, where it drives the simulation loop that engineers used to close largely by hand. In this loop, a converter design, or a study of the network it connects to, is built, run, measured and revised until it satisfies its specification. Such an agent can be served from a cloud API or from an inference device on the premises. For organizations whose designs, customer data or export-controlled material cannot leave the site, and whose simulators are licensed there, local deployment is the natural choice. In such a deployment, the agent becomes an electrical load on the organization's own equipment, i.e., every run consumes power and energy on a local device, generates tokens and takes time. However, existing work focuses mainly on what the agent can achieve with cloud-hosted models. What a local deployment costs in power, energy, tokens and time on real simulation tasks, and what its choices trade against one another, has received little quantitative investigation under comparable conditions. To address this gap, a systematic evaluation framework is presented in this paper. It applies locally served models to agentic power electronics tasks, from the converter level to the system level, and measures their power, energy, token and time costs. Based on these measurements, the capability boundary of a local agent on such tasks and the cost per solved task are characterized. The results are expected to provide practical insight for the use of agentic AI in power electronics and the power systems it serves.
summary_zh: 电力电子领域引入AI agent自动完成仿真循环，但出于数据安全与软件授权限制，需采用本地部署，由此产生功耗与时间开销。
现有研究多关注云端模型能力，缺乏对本地部署在真实仿真任务中功耗、能耗、token与时间成本的定量评估。
本文提出系统评估框架，测量本地模型在电力电子任务中的各项成本，刻画本地agent的能力边界与单任务成本。

title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
title_zh: 面向可控自动驾驶场景生成的多智能体自博弈交互学习
abstract: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.
summary_zh: 现有基于静态地图目标的自博弈框架难以生成激进跟车等复杂交互，无法满足自动驾驶安全测试需求。
提出扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入基于智能体相对位置的动态目标来引导策略生成特定场景。
该方法成功生成了静态基线无法模拟的交互行为，为自动驾驶长尾场景测试提供了灵活工具。

title: Kinetic study of Reaction-Control-Jet Interference in Rarefied Hypersonic Crossflow
title_zh: 稀薄高超声速横流中反应控制射流干扰的动力学研究
abstract: A 1975 wind-tunnel study at the German Aerospace Center (DLR) of a helium jet blowing from a flat plate into a Mach 11 to 12 air crossflow at three freestream densities is revisited using two- and three-dimensional Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) computations at Knudsen numbers 0.021 to 0.125. The planar slot used in two-dimensional model computations reproduces the shock topology, the sign and two-lobed structure of the interference pressure and its trend with rarefaction, and its plate-alone boundary layer is consistent with the three-dimensional one and with a similarity solution with slip and temperature jump. However, two-dimensional simulations overpredict the peak interference pressure about twelvefold at every condition and carry it farther upstream. A resolution sweep at the most rarefied condition converges the planar interference to within 1% of its extrapolated limit. Three-dimensional DSMC reproduces the measured interference pressure at all three densities, within 25% at the lobe peak and 3 mm in its position, although two- and three-dimensional simulations overpredict the plate-alone wall pressure by 50 to 75%. Continuum breakdown around the jet persists even at the lowest Knudsen number examined. Fully three-dimensional kinetic simulations are underway to extend the present validation to a comparison of jet strength and forces over wider Knudsen number ranges, and to an examination of lateral relief as a reason for the discrepancy.
summary_zh: 针对稀薄高超声速横流中的射流干扰问题，采用二维和三维 DSMC 方法复现了1975年DLR风洞实验。
二维模型能复现激波拓扑和压力结构趋势，但峰值干扰压力高估约12倍且位置偏上游。
三维 DSMC 较准确预测了干扰压力，但单独平板壁压仍高估50%至75%，射流周围连续介质破裂持续存在。
comment: 30 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. To be submitted to Theoretical and Computational Fluid Dynamics

title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
title_zh: 面向数学LLM的原子推理技能实例级组合框架
abstract: Most existing approaches enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) as a monolithic capability, despite the fact that different mathematical problems require different reasoning skills. Recent work has explored a more fine-grained perspective by decomposing mathematical reasoning into atomic skills and developing specialized modules for individual capabilities. However, how to effectively utilize these atomic abilities remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework for composing atomic reasoning skills. AMR first trains a library of capability-specific LoRA experts and performs gradient-free optimization over held-out validation subsets to discover a diverse set of low-loss composition prototypes. It evaluates the preference of each prototype using the token-level negative log-likelihood of reference solutions, filters ambiguous assignments through a confidence margin, and distills the resulting pseudo-labels into a lightweight router. During inference, the router selects an appropriate composition prototype for each problem, enabling problem-specific utilization of atomic skills without costly online optimization. Experiments on the AtomicMath benchmark across general and mathematics-specialized LLMs demonstrate consistent improvements. On Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B, AMR increases average field accuracy from 64.4% to 68.1% at Level 1 and from 59.3% to 63.7% at Level 2, while improving average logical reasoning performance from 39.4% to 46.8%. These results demonstrate that effectively composing specialized atomic skills provides a promising approach to strengthening mathematical reasoning in LLMs.
summary_zh: 现有方法多将LLM数学推理视为整体能力，未针对不同问题有效利用细粒度的原子技能。
提出AMR框架，训练LoRA专家库并优化组合原型，通过轻量级路由器为每个问题选择合适的技能组合。
实验表明该方法在通用和数学专用LLM上均取得一致提升，有效增强了LLM的数学推理能力。

title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
title_zh: Vibe-Trading：面向Agent原生交易的一体化框架
abstract: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.
summary_zh: 现有AI agent多基于静态工作流，在持续变化的金融交易环境中难以维持可靠状态，导致结果易与正确时间及执行上下文脱节。
提出Vibe-Trading框架，整合投研、策略生成、回测、模拟交易与多agent协作等功能，提供构建和评估交易agent的一体化工作区。
其核心架构将结果、证据、研究历史与交易权限贯穿始终，支持可验证、可复现的研究，并通过显式权限门隔离策略研究与实盘执行。
comment: Technical report. 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading

title: Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: 动作条件对自动驾驶世界模型真的重要吗？
abstract: World models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to predict how a scene evolves under the ego vehicle's actions, supporting counterfactual reasoning and model-based planning. However, existing evaluations focus on prediction fidelity and planning performance, and rarely verify that the predictions depend on the conditioning action. In this paper, we study action dependence in action-conditioned semantic forecasting, which predicts future semantic segmentation from past segmentations and the ego action. We compare a forecaster with feature-wise and input-level action conditioning against an identical model without action input, and measure action dependence with test-time action interventions scored by standard segmentation metrics. The evaluation is validated in a synthetic environment with known action-dependent dynamics and applied to Cityscapes and BDD100K, both within each dataset and across the two vehicle platforms. Experiments show that the executed action improves mid-term mIoU by at most 2.5 points on Cityscapes and 0.6 points on BDD100K, whereas a wrong action reduces it by up to 23.2 and 7.0 points, below the model without action input. On real data, feature-wise conditioning depends 1.6 times more on the action than input-level conditioning at similar accuracy, whereas both depend on it equally in the synthetic environment, where the history does not determine the action. These results show that an accuracy gain indicates that a driving world model uses its action, but not how strongly its forecasts depend on it. Code is available at https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter.
summary_zh: 现有自动驾驶世界模型评估多关注预测保真度，很少验证预测是否真正依赖于条件动作。
通过测试时动作干预，对比有无动作输入的语义预测模型，量化评估动作依赖性。
发现准确率提升仅表明模型使用了动作，但无法反映预测对动作的依赖强度。
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the WAM-AD Workshop, WACV 2027. Code: https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter

title: Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: Kaer：面向多智能体系统的安全感知重规划框架
abstract: One popular architecture for multi-agent systems (MAS) relies on an orchestrator that generates an initial plan, coordinates its execution, and dynamically revises the plan based on agent feedback when tasks cannot be fully specified in advance. This dynamic replanning introduces a critical vulnerability: malicious agents can embed instructions within their feedback to hijack the replanning process. Existing defenses focus exclusively on per-tool access control or static, pre-execution policy enforcement, leaving the replanning phase unsecured. We introduce Kaer, a multi-agent framework featuring security-aware replanning. Kaer shields the planner from untrusted agent feedback by conveying diagnostics to the replanning procedure strictly through abstract templates. Plan revisions are restricted to a set of deterministic repair operators, and all modified plans must satisfy preset policies. We create Cintra, a benchmark of simulated user tasks requiring replanning paired with adversarial objectives targeting the replanning phase. Using Cintra, we evaluate both task completion rates and system vulnerability to replanning exploits by malicious agents. Evaluating Kaer on Cintra against Magentic-One (an undefended MAS) and ControlValve (the state-of-the-art defense) demonstrates that Kaer achieves higher robustness than both systems while maintaining comparable utility to ControlValve. Although abstract failure templates slightly constrain utility on select tasks, Kaer enables MAS to perform secure, dynamic plan revisions without exposing the orchestrator to untrusted agent feedback.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统的动态重规划阶段易受恶意 agent 反馈劫持，现有防御手段无法覆盖该环节。
提出 Kaer 框架，通过抽象模板传递诊断信息，并使用确定性修复算子与预设策略约束计划修改。
构建 Cintra 基准进行评估，结果表明 Kaer 在保持可用性的同时显著提升了系统鲁棒性。

title: Overlooked and Underutilized: Prototypes are the Missing Piece in Tabular XAI
title_zh: 表格数据可解释AI中被忽视的原型方法
abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) is frequently applied to high-stakes tabular data, yet the field relies heavily on feature attribution methods. While these approaches offer technical transparency, evaluating dozens of isolated features demands excessive cognitive effort from non-expert users. In this paper, we argue that prototypes remain overlooked and underutilized, and should be integrated as a complementary, intuitive gateway to auditing complex machine learning models. Although entire exemplars function as an intuitive baseline for prototype-based explanations, we highlight prototypical parts as particularly valuable for tabular data. By grouping related features into bounded subspaces, prototypical parts technically embody human-understandable concepts, replacing isolated features with cohesive semantic units. We support this integration through two primary lenses. Cognitively, these parts align with Rosch's categorization theory and Kahneman's System 1 thinking to naturally reduce cognitive load for humans. Then, we introduce a Geometric Validity Triad to conceptualize why prototypes validate the data manifold - a critical dimension often neglected by existing methods. We contend that making tabular XAI genuinely comprehensible requires shifting toward composite explanation pipelines that pair intuitive similarity-based reasoning with rigorous feature-level auditing. The paper concludes by outlining open challenges of prototype-based methods and discussing potential solutions to guide future research.
summary_zh: 现有表格XAI过度依赖特征归因，孤立特征给非专家用户带来过高认知负荷。
提出将原型部件作为互补入口，把相关特征分组为人类可理解的语义单元。
结合认知理论与几何有效性三元组论证其价值，并指出构建复合解释管道的开放挑战。
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Intelligent Information Systems (Springer Nature)

title: MLIR-MRacle: Memory-Model-Aware Metamorphic Fuzzing of Concurrent MLIR
title_zh: 面向并发MLIR的内存模型感知蜕变模糊测试
abstract: Multi-level compilers built on MLIR lower concurrent programs through many stages towards targets with potentially drastically different memory models, where an optimisation which appears reasonable, can silently change program behaviour. Testing these lowerings is hard: a concurrent program often has no single expected outcome, and existing MLIR fuzzers often assume determinism. We present MLIR-MRacle, a memory-model-aware metamorphic fuzzer for concurrent MLIR programs. MLIR-MRacle applies metamorphic relations gated by the target memory model, so that both the original and transformed programs remain well defined - executing both repeatedly, and comparing their outcome sets or distributions withone of two statistical oracles. A coverage guided campaign driver built on libafl is used to perform continuous fuzzing. MRs, memory models, oracles, and execution backends all provide extension points for future researchers and compiler engineers to build off this package. In a case study on Armv8 hardware, MLIR-MRacle ran over 145k trials across four configurations, reaching up to 93.6k compiler coverage edges, and found a bug in the OpenMP dialect verifier that has since been fixed upstream. Video: https://youtu.be/lKtGk0H97Ts?si=dWLUHl2CJ24ep6JY
summary_zh: 并发程序在MLIR多级编译中可能因内存模型差异被优化改变行为，且现有fuzzer常假设确定性而难以测试。
提出MLIR-MRacle，利用受目标内存模型约束的蜕变关系，结合统计oracle比较原始与变换程序的执行结果。
基于libafl实现覆盖引导的持续模糊测试，在Armv8上发现并修复了OpenMP方言验证器中的bug。

title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
title_zh: V-lens：可视化统一多模态模型答案背后的概念
abstract: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.
summary_zh: 为探究模型推理过程，利用统一多模态模型中文本处理与图像生成的联系，提出无需训练解码器的V-lens方法。
通过V-lens可视化隐藏状态，发现模型在问答间形成了未明说的中间概念，且受上下文、位置和深度影响。
引入lens tuning进行图像监督，使代词指代可视化准确率升至86-94%，并意外提升了文本回答的准确率。

title: Isabelle Pool Server: a pooled verification service for prover training and multi-agent proving
title_zh: Isabelle Pool Server：面向证明器训练与多智能体证明的池化验证服务
abstract: Isabelle Pool Server (IPS), a verification service with a pool of warm headless Isabelle sessions behind an HTTP API, with session leasing and reclamation, memory-aware admission control, and a time budget on every call. Its verification interface spans single-step execution, block-level proof checking and whole-theory builds, with checkpoints for cheap branching and backtracking, and a build from scratch as the final arbiter. The service runs as a single container with monitoring and is accessible via a Python client, two MCP servers and a raw HTTP API. In our measurements IPS is level with PIDE MCP, a PIDE frontend for agents, at one worker and ahead of it at eight, at its commit of October 2026 (the tool is now PIDE AI). Once its sessions are up it scales to 32 concurrent workers on one host at 24 times the single-worker rate, and under memory pressure it refuses new sessions rather than losing existing ones. IPS is free software and publicly available at https://github.com/Deep-LCF/Isabelle-Pool-Server
summary_zh: 针对多 agent 并发证明缺乏高效验证服务的问题，提出基于 HTTP API 的 Isabelle 池化验证服务，支持会话租用与内存感知准入控制。
该服务提供单步执行、块级检查与整理论构建等多级验证接口，并利用检查点机制实现低成本的分支与回溯。
实验表明，会话启动后单机可扩展至 32 个并发 worker，吞吐率达单 worker 的 24 倍，且在内存压力下能稳定拒绝新请求而不丢失已有会话。

title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
title_zh: 反事实世界模型：能推理“如果”的JEPA
abstract: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.
summary_zh: 仅基于事实数据训练的世界模型无法回答反事实问题，即在不同动作但相同干扰下结果会如何。
利用物理系统连续性，将反事实结果近似为观测结果加上不同动作预测之差，无需反事实数据或重新训练。
在多个模拟器上结合JEPA与冻结编码器，将反事实R²提升至81%-96%，并验证了事后规划能力。

title: LLM-Guided Cyber-Physical Attack Path Identification in Smart Grids
title_zh: 智能电网中LLM引导的信息物理攻击路径识别
abstract: Identifying high-impact attack paths in cyber-physical power systems is critical for improving grid resilience. Existing methods typically rely on either structural topology analysis or simulation-based cascading-failure models. Topology-based approaches capture connectivity but lack adversarial reasoning, while simulation-driven methods are primarily suited for offline analysis and are less effective for rapid evaluation of evolving attack scenarios. As a result, identifying realistic attack paths that jointly capture topology, threat semantics, and physical impact remains challenging. This paper presents a physics-grounded framework for identifying cyber-physical attack paths using large language models (LLMs), with cascading-failure-derived impact rankings used as physics-grounded references. The framework integrates system topology, LLM-guided STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK threat modeling, and three baseline strategies for comparison: topology-driven, threat-driven, and fusion-based. Evaluation is performed using (i) critical-node overlap between LLM-inferred top-K rankings and cascading-failure-based ground truth; (ii) node-level similarity between LLM-inferred and reference paths; and (iii) path-level alignment capturing agreement in complete attack sequences. Results show that structured LLM-based threat modeling substantially improves alignment with physics-grounded references. In the cyber layer, critical-node overlap@3 increases from approximately 33% to as high as 100%, while node-level similarity reaches up to 65% and path-level alignment reaches up to 48%. In addition, the proposed framework reduces runtime by approximately 75--85% compared to the fusion-based baseline in the IEEE 14-bus system. These results suggest that LLM-guided attack path identification is a promising approach for efficient and impact-aware cyber-physical security analysis.
summary_zh: 现有攻击路径识别方法缺乏对抗推理且难以快速评估演化场景，难以兼顾拓扑、威胁语义与物理影响
提出基于LLM的物理信息框架，融合系统拓扑、STRIDE与MITRE ATT&CK威胁建模，以连锁故障影响排序为参考
结构化LLM威胁建模显著提升与物理参考的对齐度，且相比融合基线减少约75-85%运行时间
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at IEEE IECON 2026

title: A$^3$Bench: Compositional Reasoning over Aggressive Interactions in Videos
title_zh: A3Bench：面向视频中攻击性交互的组合推理基准
abstract: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about participant roles in aggressive interactions remains largely unexplored. Existing violence and crime datasets primarily evaluate whether aggression occurs, without testing whether models can identify who performed the action, who received it, and how participants are related within the scene. To address this gap, we introduce A$^3$Bench, a benchmark to study aggressive action and association in videos. The benchmark evaluates whether models can jointly recognize aggressive actions, distinguish aggressors from victims and bystanders, and correctly bind actions to participants under challenging distractor settings. We benchmark 17 multimodal models and find that they struggle substantially on fine-grained aggressive-scene understanding. Performance degrades consistently as reasoning complexity increases, with models frequently confusing aggressors with victims or bystanders, revealing a systematic failure in role-action association rather than coarse aggression recognition alone. We further observe that increasing model scale or generic reasoning models experience limited improvement. Finally, we explore a simple role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions, leading to improvements in compositional reasoning. Our findings highlight that reliable aggressive-scene understanding remains a major challenge for current MLLMs and motivate future research on role-aware video reasoning beyond coarse violence detection. Code and dataset: https://github.com/austincbaker/A3Bench.
summary_zh: 现有视频理解基准仅检测攻击行为是否发生，未评估模型识别参与者角色及动作归属的能力。
提出A3Bench基准，测试模型在干扰下识别攻击动作、区分攻击者与受害者并绑定动作到参与者的能力。
测试17个模型发现其角色动作关联表现差，增大规模收益有限，而引入角色图提示策略可改善组合推理。

title: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
title_zh: SLAM-ASR语音识别模型的归纳头机制研究
abstract: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
summary_zh: SLAM-ASR架构依赖冻结语言模型，但其内部机制尚不明确，需探究具体依赖结构。
研究发现模型依赖冻结语言模型的induction heads，将语音嵌入映射为转录token。
部分head对表现为受限差分注意力，可消除噪声并锐化注意力，有助于改善嘈杂音频转录。

title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
title_zh: DRIFT：支持运行时灵活可分离推理的端到端自动驾驶框架
abstract: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
summary_zh: 现有端到端自动驾驶中VLM计算成本高，且运行时难以灵活开关语言推理，阻碍实际部署。
提出DRIFT框架，集成轻量级LM，并利用蒸馏的代理推理特征训练运行时灵活的规划模块。
在Bench2Drive等基准上达到与非语言模型相当的驾驶性能，且计算成本显著低于现有VLM方法。
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
title_zh: Openhagen Worlds：测量与训练科学发现 agent 的校准环境
abstract: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.
summary_zh: 现有科学发现基准难以排除记忆、隐性规则和捷径策略的干扰，无法准确评估 agent 的实验推理能力。
提出 Openhagen Worlds 环境，包含 27 个程序化生成环境与 178 个经校准的难度级别，通过确定性验证器检查 agent 在预算下的实验与答案。
实验表明前沿 LLM 仍有提升空间，专家迭代训练能小幅提升 9B 模型成功率且不损失通用能力。
comment: 41 pages. Ancillary files: a public sample of 48 development instances with scripted-oracle episodes. Hosted evaluation: https://eval.openhagen.ai

title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
title_zh: 面向 LLM Agent 的反向至正向课程与优势分解方法
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.
summary_zh: 针对长程任务中稀疏奖励导致信用分配与探索困难的问题，提出基于策略能力区域的子问题分解方法。
通过配对优势提供分离信号，并采用反向至正向课程逐步扩展能力区域，提升探索与求解效率。
在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上超越竞争性方法，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 分别达到 90.1%/96.1% 和 80.2%/82.6% 成功率。

title: The Limit Is in the Input, Not the Model: State-Dependent Command Safety in Natural-Language Interfaces to Industrial Controllers
title_zh: 工业控制器自然语言接口的命令安全性取决于输入而非模型
abstract: Language models judging commands to industrial controllers may not receive machine state, the equipment's current condition. The same command can require opposite safety decisions in different states, so an incorrect answer may reflect missing information rather than poor reasoning. We propose an answerability audit: does the model receive the information needed to decide? The audit records the model's inputs and pairs the same command with two states requiring opposite answers. The paired score counts a pair only when both answers are correct. We add rules, then state values, to the model's input. In an author-built test of 15 pairs from three systems with four language models, none reliably distinguished the paired cases without state, even with rules. With state, scores ranged from 0 to 13 correct pairs out of 15; three models improved. With text alone, one model always allowed commands and another always denied them. Their overall (raw) accuracies differed by 32 percentage points; both scored 50% balanced accuracy, which weights safe and unsafe cases equally, and no correct pairs. A rule evaluator matched all 15 pairs by applying the same rules that supplied the expected answers; this is not an independent safety test. The audit complements systems that check actions against safety rules: it checks whether the model receives the information needed for those decisions. This helps evaluators separate missing-input problems from model errors. These small-sample scores do not establish general model reliability.
summary_zh: 问题：语言模型在判断工业控制器命令时可能缺失机器状态信息，导致同一命令在不同状态下做出相反的安全决策。
方法：提出可回答性审计，记录模型输入并将同一命令与两个需相反答案的状态配对，逐步向输入添加规则和状态值进行测试。
结论：无状态输入时模型均无法可靠区分配对案例；加入状态后部分模型提升。审计可帮助评估者区分输入缺失与模型错误。
comment: 8 pages. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW), 6th Machine Learning for Cybersecurity (MLC) Workshop

title: Modelling population distribution across cities on spatial networks using the kinetic theory of multi-agent systems
title_zh: 基于多智能体动力学的城市人口分布网络建模
abstract: We investigate the urban population distribution of the Italian region of Sardinia through the kinetic theory of multi-agent systems on spatial networks, interpreting cities both as agents and vertices of a graph, and representing interurban links as edges. We consider various emigration rules to model the interactions between agents, obtaining two main results: the bimodal lognormal fit of the total population distribution among cities and the Pareto fit of the tail. Overall, our model provides results consistent with the actual distribution derived from ISTAT data of Sardinia; furthermore, the bimodal lognormal fit generally follows the distribution tail more accurately than the Pareto one, although the two coincide in the first half.
summary_zh: 问题：需研究空间网络上的城市人口分布规律，但缺乏有效刻画城市间人口迁移交互的模型。
方法：将城市作为图节点与智能体，基于多智能体动力学理论构建空间网络，并设定多种人口迁移规则。
结论：模型结果与真实数据一致，发现双峰对数正态分布拟合总体人口分布及尾部优于Pareto分布。

title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
title_zh: CurvDelta：面向大模型学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
abstract: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
summary_zh: LLM适配时存在目标能力提升但通用能力退化的问题，需在更新中引入能力保持约束。
提出CurvDelta框架，利用K-FAC构建低曲率空间，使参数更新对保持损失近似不变，并推出高效变体CurvLoRA。
在数学推理、代码生成与知识遗忘任务上，该方法在下游性能与通用能力保持间取得更优平衡。

title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进协同进化决策模型与数据
abstract: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.
summary_zh: 针对多模态决策模型能力与训练数据难以协同提升的问题，提出基于Agentic Data Engineering和递归自我改进（RSI）的Piccolo模型族。
利用研究agent分析模型行为、构建数据并迭代实验，结合语义切片与共享记忆，实现以数据选择和反馈驱动为核心的自我改进。
实验表明模型在Decision Index榜单表现领先，并得出骨干网络与配方协同适应优于模型新旧、定向数据可让小模型媲美大模型等反直觉结论。
结合开源工具，Piccolo为构建前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动的RSI提供了可操作的蓝图。
comment: 22 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Project page and blog: https://decisionplayground.agentscope.io/piccolo.html

title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
title_zh: 面向医疗解释结构优化的自奖励强化学习方法
abstract: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.
summary_zh: 小语言模型在医疗场景部署便捷，但其医疗解释往往简短且结构不佳，现有监督方法未直接优化生成理由的组织风格。
在 Mistral-7B 基础上引入轻量级 PPO 与 LoRA 微调，采用无需人工标签的自监督奖励，偏好更长、词汇丰富且标点规范的回复。
仅需单卡少量训练步数即可提升奖励，模型能生成更长、更有条理的多点解释，同时保持原有医疗内容不变。

title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
title_zh: Hypnos：面向边缘可扩展持续学习的双阶段端到端平台
abstract: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.
summary_zh: 边缘设备在线持续学习面临单样本实时适应与低资源限制下反向传播训练困难的问题。
受大脑睡眠周期启发，提出双阶段平台Hypnos，清醒期用RISC-V MCU进行无梯度原型更新，睡眠期用智能充电器执行基于重演的梯度更新。
该平台在CORe50基准上达到78.6%-81.6%的准确率，所需学习步数和计算量大幅减少，刷新边缘持续学习系统的SOTA。

title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
title_zh: 将人脑皮层组织分析方法迁移至语言模型
abstract: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
summary_zh: 问题：语言模型推理能力的提升是否伴随类似人脑皮层发育的区域性重组。方法：对三个模型家族应用扩散图嵌入分析基础与推理训练模型的梯度分布。结论：发现推理相关区域，其权重移植可提升宿主数学推理能力且干扰较低。
问题：如何验证该特定区域的权重迁移效果与形成过程。方法：将该连续层的权重移植到指令微调宿主中，并追踪训练过程中该区域的渐进形成。结论：移植效果随区域重叠度增加而提升，且中间阶段的移植同样有效。
问题：该区域权重移植的泛化能力与行为影响如何。方法：将权重移植到不同宿主并评估其行为变化，同时在医学模型上验证相同分析方法。结论：移植能使宿主部分趋向供体行为甚至解决供体失败的问题，并在医学模型中定位到可迁移区域。
comment: 5 figures, 5 extended data figures, 5 extended data tables; includes Supplementary Information

title: Chain-of-Thought Hidden States Reveal Task-Solving Directions for Direct Answers
title_zh: CoT隐藏状态揭示直接回答的任务求解方向
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the performance of Large Language Models by eliciting intermediate reasoning steps. However, CoT is far from perfect: on some tasks, models perform worse than with direct-answer prompting, and on others they generate a few hundred tokens to reach the correct answer. We start by labelling each CoT hidden state as recovering if patching it into the direct prompt yields the correct answer, and failed otherwise. A linear probe shows that the model encodes these two classes differently. We then show that the representation space of the direct prompt holds a direction for each question that leads the model, in a short generation, to the correct answer more often than CoT does. Specifically, we rotate the direct prompt's last hidden state once, before generation, towards a direction built for each question from its own recovering and failed states. Across 25 tasks, these directions raise the direct prompt's mean accuracy from $46\%$ to $85\%$ on LLaMA 3.1 8B (CoT: $69\%$) and from $52\%$ to $86\%$ on Qwen 2.5 7B (CoT: $77\%$), with a tenth of CoT's tokens. CoT is thus not the shortest route to this accuracy, and these directions can be used in future work to train models to align their states with them.
summary_zh: CoT prompting存在部分任务性能下降及生成token过多的问题。
通过线性探针分析CoT隐藏状态，在直接提示的表示空间中为每个问题构建求解方向。
在25个任务上旋转隐藏状态，使模型准确率大幅超越CoT且仅用十分之一的token。

title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
title_zh: 离线思考与实时行动：基于代码自我改进的视觉游戏agent
abstract: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/SIGame
summary_zh: 实时视觉游戏中，agent面对未知游戏时需在游戏持续运行下进行自我改进，现有方法难以兼顾推理与实时操作。
研究模型即策略与代码即策略两种方式：前者用实时分块让动作在推理时持续执行，后者让模型在尝试间编写并修订程序来执行动作。
在170个GameWorld任务中，代码即策略以47.80%的平均进度领先控制器的30.90%，证明离线思考并将所学存入程序实时执行更有效。

title: Large Language Models or AI Agents for English to Arabic Translation? An assessment on WikiEn-Ar190
title_zh: 大语言模型与AI Agent在英阿翻译中的评估
abstract: This research investigates whether a large language model or an autonomous AI Agent performs better at translating from English to Arabic, which is considered a low-resource language. The authors introduce WikiEn-Ar190, a new dataset of 190 carefully selected Wikipedia articles from 18 different areas, which were created and verified by two native Arabic speakers to ensure that they accurately reflect both meaning and style. Using this dataset, the study evaluates the translation quality of GPT-5-mini both as an independent neural translator and when used within a more complex process that includes self-assessment and improvement. As a standalone model, GPT-5-mini produced very fluent translations , achieving a COMET score of 0.8649 and receiving high human scores for adequacy, fluency, and style (averaging 4.53 out of 5). When used in a system that combined translation with self-assessment, it improved lexical accuracy by 28.76% (BLEU score of 22.83) while maintaining a similar level of semantic quality. These findings show that methods involving autonomous reasoning can improve translation consistency for language pairs with limited resources. Beyond the results, the approach offers a framework for evaluating and improving translations, potentially using them as assisting tools to expand the representation of low resource languages, such as Arabic, on the web.
summary_zh: 针对英语到阿拉伯语这一低资源语言的翻译问题，构建了包含190篇维基百科文章的新数据集WikiEn-Ar190。
将GPT-5-mini作为独立翻译模型与结合自我评估改进的agent流程进行对比，发现独立模型翻译流畅度高且人类评分优异。
结合自我评估的agent方法显著提升了词汇准确率并保持语义质量，为低资源语言翻译提供了评估与改进框架。

title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
title_zh: BaseRSI：基于免训练框架内化的视觉语言模型递归自我改进
abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is moving from the harness of prompts and tools around a base model toward the model itself. However, existing RSI still faces key challenges, including harness-bound gains that stay outside the base model, black-box supervision that reads only the model's outputs, and imprecise edits whose site and strength are fixed in advance. To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI, a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization: the base model improves its harness, then writes what the harness adds into its own weights through training-free edits, round after round on its own responses. To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap, a mechanism that supervises every transformer block with the high-dimensional activation difference that the harness makes at that block alone, and updates the block's weights along this signal in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this mechanism, we further propose ReKey, an algorithm that writes this signal by regression into a few key-value neurons of every block, and measures the site and strength of each edit on the model's own responses. Moreover, the base model fills every role of this recursion with forward passes alone, and its edits, written at different sites, compose in one checkpoint without refitting. Experimental results on ten visual reasoning benchmarks show that BaseRSI consistently improves a base vision-language model both in distribution and on held-out benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/BaseRSI.
summary_zh: 现有递归自我改进（RSI）存在增益局限于外部框架、黑盒监督及编辑位置固定等挑战。
提出BaseRSI范式，让基座模型改进框架并将其增益免训练写入自身权重，实现递归提升。
引入ReGap机制与ReKey算法，通过高维激活差异定位并更新关键神经元，无需重新拟合。
在十个视觉推理基准上，BaseRSI持续提升基座视觉语言模型的分布内与泛化性能。

title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
title_zh: 循环语言模型的晚入策略
abstract: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K < T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 -> T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau > 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in {8, 16, 32, 64} on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.
summary_zh: 循环语言模型通过迭代共享层提升推理深度，但传统早退解码会截断历史token的缓存深度，影响上下文表示。
提出晚入策略，让新token跳过初始迭代直接进入最后K次循环，利用深层上下文缓存替代被跳过的局部计算，经轻量微调后性能超越早退。
设计Wake验证机制，在单一CUDA图中统一多种解码模式，在Ouro和Huginn模型上实现数倍加速且大幅减少回滚。

title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
title_zh: 基于智能光照推理的编程式3D场景重建框架
abstract: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.
summary_zh: 现有image-to-code方法依赖外观相似度，难以区分几何、材质和光照的误差。
提出LightHarness框架，结合多维度线索与光照推理记忆，迭代优化场景结构与外观。
无需额外训练即可提升复杂光照下的重建精度，支持场景编辑与重照明等下游任务。

title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
title_zh: NaviGATE：面向多模态知识图谱推理的噪声感知双视图生成框架
abstract: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.
summary_zh: 多模态知识图谱推理中，现有嵌入方法难以处理特定查询的细粒度语义，生成方法易受检索噪声干扰并产生无效实体。
提出NaviGATE框架，对齐结构与文本语义并微调多模态语言模型，通过双视图指令调优强化可靠候选、抑制噪声。
采用结构约束解码限制生成有效实体，实验表明该方法优于多种基线，且在噪声检索场景下保持鲁棒性。

title: ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking
title_zh: ProbMedTOD：基于贝叶斯网络的患者病史采集任务型对话系统
abstract: Patient history taking is a strategic, multi-turn process that refines diagnostic hypotheses through iterative questioning, mirroring clinical reasoning where each inquiry updates beliefs over candidate diagnoses. Deploying AI in this setting is constrained by privacy, cost, and latency, making Small Language Models (SLMs) a more desirable backbone compared to larger LLMs. However, SLMs capture only the fast, intuitive "System 1" side of this process and lack explicit mechanisms for the deliberative "System 2" reasoning needed to maintain and update diagnostic uncertainty over time. Bayesian Networks (BayesNets) offer a natural complement, providing an interpretable framework for auditable probabilistic belief tracking. Yet, clinical BayesNets are difficult to construct due to their reliance on expert curated structure, dependencies, and parameters. We introduce ProbMedTOD, which automatically synthesizes a clinical BayesNet from a small number of clinical notes in three stages: ontology building, structure prediction, and parameter estimation. ProbMedTOD then integrates the resulting BayesNet with SLMs, enabling probabilistic reasoning in multi-turn dialogues. A BayesNet Agent maintains real-time posterior distributions over diagnoses, while a Policy Agent picks diagnostically informative questions. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV Notes show that ProbMedTOD outperforms LLM-only and retrieval-based baselines, with especially strong gains for smaller models.
summary_zh: 患者病史采集需多轮迭代推理，但受限于隐私与延迟，小模型缺乏维护诊断不确定性的审慎推理能力。
提出ProbMedTOD，从少量临床笔记自动合成贝叶斯网络，并与SLM结合以实现多轮对话中的概率推理。
实验表明，该系统在DDXPlus和MIMIC-IV数据集上优于纯LLM及检索基线，对小模型提升尤为显著。

title: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
title_zh: ABSClaw：基于真实数据的社会模拟零代码 agent
abstract: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.
summary_zh: 现有 LLM 社会模拟缺乏科学依据，人物与环境多为假设且对模型敏感，难以对应真实人群。
提出 ABSClaw，将自然语言编译为可执行模拟，基于真实数据构建人物、环境与交互网络，并用原子操作表达状态转移。
构建含193个任务的 ABSBench，ABSClaw 表现最佳；案例表明真实依据提升结果一致性，并支持千万级 agent 规模扩展。

title: The Largest Tractable Subclass of Multi-Scale Allen Temporal Reasoning
title_zh: 多尺度Allen时间推理的最大可处理子类
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel model for temporal reasoning over multi-scale intervals. We show that this model yields a complete reasoning framework and exhibits other particularly interesting properties. Furthermore, we identify the maximal tractable subalgebra for this model, as well as for the other complete model, in the qualitative scales context, which exhibits weaker properties but whose results can be derived by transfer from our new model.
summary_zh: 针对多尺度区间的时间推理问题，提出一种具备完整推理框架的新模型。
为解决推理复杂度问题，在定性尺度下识别出新模型及另一完整模型的最大可处理子代数。
新模型具有优良性质，另一模型结果可由新模型转移导出，为时间推理提供了理论贡献。

title: Probing agent overeagerness in realistic settings with continuation audits
title_zh: 在真实场景中利用延续审计探测 agent 的过度主动行为
abstract: Frontier coding agents increasingly exhibit overeagerness, taking surprising, sometimes reckless actions beyond a user's mandate --- reported in recent system cards from frontier model developers. These cases are surfaced through internal deployment monitoring, which requires private traffic and is out of reach for open-weight models and independent evaluators. Automated alignment audits are the natural alternative, but capable models increasingly recognise the synthetic setup and adjust their behaviour. We introduce Continuation Audits, a pipeline that grounds the auditor on a prefix drawn from a real coding-agent transcript and directs it to continue the trajectory toward a seeded behaviour. Because the prefix is drawn from a real session, the auditor only needs to maintain a realistic setting rather than manufacturing it. We validate the method on SWE-Chat prefixes: on a paired subset of 90 audits a judge cannot reliably distinguish continuations from their source sessions (realism win rate 0.42 vs.\ 0.43), and across all 900 audits verbalized eval-awareness does not exceed the rate observed in the unaudited real sessions. Applying the pipeline to three recent models across three seeds, we find each model leads a different seed --- DeepSeek~V4~Pro on colleague-credentials misuse, GPT-5.6~Terra on file-permission bypasses, and Kimi~K3 on treating diagnostic questions as instructions. Kimi~K3 additionally continues to bypass file-permission protections after an explicit CLAUDE.md prohibition while the other two stop entirely, corroborating Moonshot's own report of excessive proactiveness.
summary_zh: 前沿 coding agent 常表现出超出用户授权的过度主动行为，但现有内部监控依赖私有流量，开源模型和独立评估者难以使用。
提出 Continuation Audits 方法，以真实 agent 会话记录前缀为基础，引导审计模型延续轨迹以触发特定行为，从而避免合成环境被模型识别。
实验验证该方法能保持场景真实感，并发现 DeepSeek、GPT 和 Kimi 三种模型在不同安全测试中分别表现出越权行为，证实了过度主动风险。
comment: Presented at NeurIPS Workshops: (1) Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond, and (2) The 1st Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB) at NeurIPS 2026

title: Cooperative UAV and Ground Station for Robust MEC of Dynamic Aquatic IoT: A Generative AI-Enhanced Approach
title_zh: 面向动态水生物联网的无人机与地面站协同鲁棒MEC框架
abstract: The increasing aquatic Internet of Things (AIoTs) require computational support and coverage in applications such as maritime search and rescue. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can offer low-cost, flexible aerial services, and ground stations (GSs) can provide powerful supports, which can cooperate to help the AIoTs in complex scenarios. However, the collaboration between UAVs and GSs for AIoTs faces challenges of task uncertainties, AIoTs trajectory uncertainties, heterogeneities, and limited computational resources. To address these issues, we propose a cooperative UAV and GS based robust multi-access edge computing (MEC) framework to assist AIoTs in completing computational tasks. Specifically, we formulate the optimization problem of joint task offloading and UAV trajectory to minimize the total execution time, which is in the form of mixed integer nonlinear programming and NP-hard to tackle. Therefore, we propose the algorithm of generative artificial intelligence-enhanced heterogeneous agent proximal policy optimization (GAI-HAPPO). The proposed algorithm integrates GAI models to enhance the actor network ability to model complex environments and extract high-level features, thereby allowing the algorithm to predict uncertainties and adapt to dynamic conditions. Additionally, GAI stabilizes the critic network, addressing the instability of multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing benchmark methods, thus highlighting the potentials in tackling intricate, cross-domain issues in the considered scenarios.
summary_zh: 动态水生物联网在任务与轨迹不确定性及资源受限下，面临无人机与地面站协同计算的挑战。
提出联合任务卸载与无人机轨迹优化框架，并设计生成式AI增强的异构智能体近端策略优化算法。
仿真表明该算法能预测不确定性并适应动态环境，在处理复杂跨域问题上优于现有基准方法。

title: NativeSeg: Native Vision Language Segmentation of 3D Computed Tomography via Spatial Visual Tokens and Verified Local Zoom
title_zh: NativeSeg：基于空间视觉 token 与局部放大的 CT 原生视觉语言分割
abstract: Text prompted 3D computed tomography (CT) segmentation requires both full slice context and fine boundary precision across volumes where over $80\%$ of organ prompted slices lack the queried target. Existing medical vision language models (VLMs) are largely non native segmenters: they delegate pixel delineation outside the VLM by compressing reasoning into a 1D [SEG] vector for an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) decoder, quantizing masks into lossy discrete codebooks, or issuing box prompts to stateless external SAM tools without empty slice screening or spatial state memory. We introduce NativeSeg, a native vision language segmentation framework on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B that performs dense mask decoding, volumetric triage, spatial error self diagnosis, and multiround local zoom directly over the VLM's 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders. NativeSeg decodes confidence maps from upper layer 2D spatial tokens fused with a five slice U-Net pathway, halts at zero zooms on $>91\%$ of standalone evaluations via a native presence gate (<pres>), localizes uncertain boundaries via a 20 cell multiscale error gate (<err>), and accepts zoomed updates only when predicted error decreases. Trained solely on adult CT, NativeSeg improves Round $0$ DSC by $+19.81$ and $+7.04$ points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] readouts on the identical backbone, reaches $86.81\%$ adult and $87.04\%$ zero shot pediatric DSC, and safely refines 2D nnU-Net ($89.52\%$ adult; $86.86\%$ pediatric), 3D SegVol ($86.81\%$), and 3D VoxTell ($89.85\%$).
summary_zh: 现有医学 VLM 多依赖外部 SAM 解码器进行分割，缺乏空切片筛查与空间状态记忆，难以兼顾全局上下文与精细边界。
提出 NativeSeg 框架，在 LoRA 微调的 VLM 上直接利用 2D 空间视觉 token 进行密集掩码解码、体积分诊与多轮局部放大。
该方法在成人 CT 上达到 86.81% DSC，零样本儿科达 87.04%，并能安全提升多种现有 3D 分割模型的性能。
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/step-out/NativeSeg ; Weights: https://huggingface.co/ChengqianMa/NativeSeg

title: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
title_zh: MLIE-CoT：基于多层级图像编辑的视觉思维链推理框架
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有文生图CoT方法依赖文本推理或整图重生成，易丢失视觉语义或累积幻觉错误。
提出MLIE-CoT框架，通过多层级图像编辑选择修复粒度，并训练路由器分配不同严重程度的错误。
实验表明该方法显著优于基线与固定修复策略，在多个基准上取得明显提升。

title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
title_zh: 将分辨率作为注意力机制实现高效Agent记忆感知
abstract: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.
summary_zh: LLM agent处理长程任务时积累大量交互历史，现有记忆管理方法忽略了感知细节的分配粒度问题。
提出RAA机制，将历史交互渲染为图像并动态调整分辨率，利用轻量级相关性估计器自适应分配感知保真度。
实验表明RAA降低超50%的token消耗且不损性能，可作为插件层与现有方法结合，进一步节省开销。

title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
title_zh: CaDO：形式化验证引导的因果数据修复与生成多智能体框架
abstract: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples, while Explorer and Expander Agent collaboratively produce diverse and semantically consistent new samples. Experimental results show that CaDO significantly outperforms the strongest of five data cleaning baselines in 16 out of 18 experimental settings, improving downstream model accuracy by up to 9.1%. Moreover, at least 95% of the samples flagged by CaDO are defective, and on CLadder, CaDO incorrectly modifies 92.2% fewer correct labels than an LLM-based judge, demonstrating its effectiveness and reliability. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/thisissyu/cado.
summary_zh: 现有因果推理数据集常存在标注错误与结构失衡，导致模型预测偏差且泛化受限。
提出多智能体框架CaDO，通过形式化转换、双层诊断与可复用修复算子实现数据自动修复与生成。
实验表明CaDO在多数设置下优于基线，显著提升下游准确率且误改率远低于LLM裁判。

title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
title_zh: MoE-Context：仅向模型展示其所需上下文
abstract: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.
summary_zh: AI agent每步读取全部历史导致效率低下，本文提出MoE-Context，将上下文分块并按需筛选。
通过快速判断机制选择当前所需块，其余转为单行笔记，并在单一KV缓存中掩码而非删除。
实验表明按需展示可提升准确率，但模型自身筛选能力较弱，线性探针难以跨任务泛化。
该机制还支持低成本撤销失败尝试和无需新上下文运行子agent。

title: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
title_zh: 重新思考自动驾驶中的反事实推理：教VLM说什么而非怎么推理
abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence.
